summary: Iteration 13 validates the three tasks (chat Generator, Flagship hero, Owner price override). All critical backend and frontend flows pass end-to-end.

minor.issue: admin@sitegenie.com (role=admin) can also override prices because is_owner() treats admin as owner. Not a bug — matches the frontend guard (isOwner = owner || admin). Just note: the 'non-owner 403' scenario is only truly guaranteed for regular users, not admins.

critical_code_review_comments: Market.jsx overridePrice() has no upper-bound client validation. Backend enforces $1–$100,000 but user could type a huge number and only see a toast. Consider matching client-side range for UX.
Generator.jsx `useEffect` seeding depends on `user?.name`; the [] deps intentionally run once, but ESLint will warn about missing `user` dep. Harmless but worth suppressing explicitly.
